Set the ProRes profile. This option is only valid if the codec has been set to `prores`. Possible values: "4444-xq", "4444", "hq", "standard", "light", "proxy". Default: `"hq"`. See [here](https://video.stackexchange.com/a/14715) for an explanation of possible values.

## CLI flag

Use `--prores-profile` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--prores-profile <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--prores-profile <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--prores-profile <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--prores-profile <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--prores-profile <value>` |
